result_assessed: 3-point MACE (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke), hazard ratio, effect of assignment (ITT)

D1_randomisation.why: [low on NEW evidence bound after the blind read] Randomisation registered in the central IV/WRS (sequence and concealment by the system: 1.1/1.2 = PY); baseline balanced. The stratification errors the FDA records were mis-entered strata, not a breach of concealment -- reviewer to confirm.

witnesses.span: Time to event or censoring was calculated as time from the randomization date (as registered in the IV/WRS system)
All of these baseline demographic characteristics appeared balanced between the two treatment arms.
The majority of the site-level PDs and approximately three-quarter of the patient-level PDs (222 PDs for 218 patients) were due to incorrect stratification

D2_deviations_assignment.why: Double-blind within dose group; FAS analysed by ITT as randomised.

witnesses.span: The SUSTAIN 6 trial was a multi-national, randomized, double-blind, and placebo-controlled cardiovascular outcome trial designed to assess cardiovascular safety of semaglutide.
The statistical evaluation of the FAS follow ed the intention-to-treat (ITT) principle and subjects contributed to the evaluation “as randomized”.

D3_missing_outcome_data.why: Vital status for 99.6% of all randomised; 13 lacked it (6 vs 7).

witnesses.span: vital status was available for 99.6% of all randomized subjects; only 13 subjects lacked vital status follow-up (6 with semaglutide; 7 with placebo).

D4_outcome_measurement.why: External independent EAC adjudicating in a blinded manner.

witnesses.span: An external independent Event Adjudication Committee (EAC) was constituted for the trial to adjudicate cardiovascular events and diabetic retinopathy events for randomized subjects in an independent and blinded manner.

D5_selection_of_reported_result.why: The FDA statistical reviewer, reading the protocol/SAP, states the MACE time-to-first-event analysis was pre-specified; no dated SAP is held -- a human should weigh a regulator's statement vs a dated plan.

witnesses.span: The primary analysis of MACE was pre-specified as a time to first event analysis.
Endpoints and methods of analysis are specified in the protocols/statistical analysis plans.

D2_treatment_discontinuation.note: stopped treatment -- recorded for D2 context; NOT missing outcome data
D2_treatment_discontinuation.why: more discontinued semaglutide for adverse events (abstract)

witnesses.span: Fewer serious adverse events occurred in the semaglutide group, although more patients discontinued treatment because of adverse events, mainly gastrointestinal.

overall.rule: RoB 2 algorithm on the proposals; not computed when any domain lacks evidence
